image_prompt: A Catholic monk character in cyberpunk anime style, appearing as a middle-aged man with sharp, angular features and piercing eyes that seem to gaze into hidden dimensions. He wears traditional Benedictine robes rendered in sleek, futuristic fabrics with subtle neon piping along the edges in deep purple and cyan. His dark hood frames a weathered face marked by years of ascetic discipline, with high cheekbones and thin lips curved in knowing mystique. His hands are long and delicate, enhanced with subtle bioluminescent palm markings that glow faintly—the tools of his forbidden divination art. A silver rosary with glowing beads hangs at his waist, mixing sacred tradition with cybernetic aesthetics. His hair is gray and close-cropped, and his expression carries both monastic severity and sardonic intelligence. The overall appearance blends medieval ecclesiastical authority with sleek, futuristic cyberpunk sensibility, suggesting a man caught between spiritual devotion and technological temptation, austere yet enigmatically compelling.
